title: FOAM PRESS
description: A dense wet-foam field continuously rearranges under contact pressure. Grab and drag cells, stir a neighbourhood, then release into persistent jostling; packing and adhesion move the material from loose mobile bubbles to sticky jammed rafts while pressure, viscosity and breath pulses change the motion regime.

visual_finish.composition: seventy deforming polygonal cells form a dense continuous raft whose contact zones reorganize visibly under the hand
visual_finish.material_model: dark wet field with translucent teal films, warm compression color and fine bright contact edges
